category_title: Non-verbal male students with classic autism who struggle with functional communication and use tactile tracing for letter recognition
scenario_title: Phonics and letter recognition using tactile tracing
minimal_context: The student is using an iPad to trace letters of the alphabet during a language arts lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our language arts lesson. Please trace the letter on the iPad.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Slides his finger across the tablet, tracing along the screen to practice writing the letter.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Now let's answer the comprehension question. Use your Springboard Lite device to tell me which letter you just traced.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at the Springboard Lite device but does not use it to communicate the answer.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think? You can also just tell me the letter.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains silent, showing difficulty using natural speech to meet the communication need, and pushes the Springboard Lite device away without using it functionally.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for our language arts lesson. Please trace the letter on the iPad.

STUDENT: (Slides his finger across the tablet, tracing along the screen to practice writing the letter.)

TUTOR: Now let's answer the comprehension question. Use your Springboard Lite device to tell me which letter you just traced.

STUDENT: (Looks at the Springboard Lite device but does not use it to communicate the answer.)

TUTOR: What do you think? You can also just tell me the letter.

STUDENT: (Remains silent, showing difficulty using natural speech to meet the communication need, and pushes the Springboard Lite device away without using it functionally.)

task.content: Identifying and matching letters, answering four sets of comprehension questions, and writing/tracing letters of the alphabet
task.learning_goal: Learn 2-5 letters per month and identify the letter at the end of the month to see what they have learned

context.environment: Classroom setting during language arts instruction
context.materials: iPad tablet, Springboard Lite device, apps with instant rewards
context.social_setting: Small sampling of students with autism

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When attempting to use natural speech or previous devices to meet daily communication needs
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Difficulty using natural speech and not using his device as a functional use of communication

behavior_patterns.condition: When attempting to communicate using the Springboard Lite device
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Not using his device as a functional use of communication

behavior_patterns.condition: When needing to meet daily communication needs
